title: Lightcarbon LCR018-D Review: A True All-Rounder (bottom-bracket recheck)
notes: Owner review by Petr Minarik, published 2026-03-23, reread for the bottom bracket only. It says: "The good news is that Lightcarbon has changed the package contents, and the bottom bracket is now included." The build lists a T47 Kocvelo bottom bracket (133 g); the owner needed a special tool and bought several. Package items named: headset bearings, spacers, compression plug, computer mount with adapters, top cap; proprietary thru-axle included. This is the owner's statement as of the review date, not a current manufacturer term; the manufacturer page read the same day lists the bottom bracket as a paid option.
